en: A vintage monochrome postcard depicting a large ornamental fountain in a landscaped park. The fountain has multiple tiers with water jets arching outward, sculpted figures around the basin, and a tall central column topped by additional statuary and a crown-like element. Trees and benches surround the fountain, and a church tower or similar structure is faintly visible on a wooded hill in the background. At the top of the postcard, in red lettering, is a caption identifying the location.
